entry.content:
Maison Margiela hand-paints this Rimowa set in Bianchetto, a white finish meant to crack and show the passage of time. With each trip, the white fades and wears into a patina no two owners will share. The brushstrokes stay visible on the aluminum Classic Cabin suitcase, which is lined with white canvas and white leather, a first for Rimowa, with its stitching and overlocked edges showing. The matching 5AC XL bag carries Rimowa's grooves over to calfskin leather, and its lining hangs past the body, so you can tuck it in or pull it out to give the bag a weekender shape. Leather loops attach the bag to the suitcase and line up the grooves from one to the other. As a memento of the collaboration, a removable black leather tag carries a single brushstroke of Bianchetto.

entry.content:
Singapore Airlines is putting more than $1.5 billion into new cabins, and the centerpiece is a First Class double bed it calls the largest in commercial aviation. Retract the divider between the two center seats and they join into a bed 60 inches across and 80 inches long, with a 32-inch 4K screen and a leather-lined vanity drawer in each suite. PriestmanGoode, the London studio behind Lufthansa's double-bed Suite Plus, designed the First Class suite. Take a virtual reality tour on the airline's website, where you can open the privacy doors and set up the double bed right in a browser to get a preview of your next flight.

entry.title: Starlink Mini 2 Satellite Internet Kit
entry.summary: Starlink's first Mini made satellite internet portable, but it still needed power nearby. The Mini 2 fixes that with a removable battery good for up to four and a half hours online. When the first runs low, you can snap in a spare. The dish is also about half an inch slimmer than
entry.content:
Starlink's first Mini made satellite internet portable, but it still needed power nearby. The Mini 2 fixes that with a removable battery good for up to four and a half hours online. When the first runs low, you can snap in a spare. The dish is also about half an inch slimmer than the original. A USB-C cable recharges the battery or can power the dish directly when you are near an outlet. The built-in Wi-Fi 6 router covers 1,800 square feet wherever you are, and an IP67 rating means dust or a quick dunk in water won't knock it out. Preorders are open by invitation in the US, and a year of service is included.

Wonderfeel Youngr is a next-generation NMN supplement designed to support cellular health as the body ages. Each two-capsule serving delivers 900mg of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), paired with antioxidants including ergothioneine, trans-resveratrol, olive fruit extract, and vitamin D3. The patented formula takes a multi-targeted approach to supporting NAD+ levels and cellular function, with the goal of promoting energy, cognitive performance, and healthy aging. The vegan, non-GMO formula is free of soy, gluten, dairy, and fish.

entry.content:
Urwerk's first watch, the UR-101 from 1997, returns in black steel with an emerald-green minute scale. Instead of traditional hands, the Green Mamba uses two satellites to carry the hour numerals across a 180-degree arc, and its position along the scale gives the minutes. The two satellites take turns, with the second picking up as the first reaches the end. The 41 mm case is coated in black PVD and measures just 10.3 mm thick, and the strap is black rubber lined with calfskin. Urwerk will make only 50 Green Mambas.

entry.summary: Vianney Halter's Antiqua, a watch with riveted portholes that debuted at Basel in 1998, became a landmark of independent watchmaking. Louis Erard's Futur Antérieur reimagines the portholes as two dials. One dial shows the hours and minutes, the other shows the seconds, and each r
entry.content:
Vianney Halter's Antiqua, a watch with riveted portholes that debuted at Basel in 1998, became a landmark of independent watchmaking. Louis Erard's Futur Antérieur reimagines the portholes as two dials. One dial shows the hours and minutes, the other shows the seconds, and each runs on its own Sellita automatic movement. Even with both movements, the stainless steel case is only 8.85 mm thick. Other details include rivets that ring the bezels and crowns, blued steel hands and an ostrich leather strap. The Gold edition has gold-toned dials and a black strap, and the Silver has silver-toned dials and a blue strap. Each edition is capped at 178 watches.

entry.content:
Muhammad Ali raised his gloves at Madison Square Garden on Dec. 7, 1970, after stopping Oscar Bonavena in the 15th round. It was his second fight since returning to the ring after a three-and-a-half-year layoff. He had predicted a ninth-round finish, but Bonavena rocked him with a hook in that round, and Ali needed until the 15th to drop his opponent three times. LIFE photographer Bill Ray shot the victory pose, and Sonic Editions prints it in a numbered edition of 495, each with a certificate on the back. The print is made on Fuji Crystal Archive paper and framed in hand-finished wood under shatterproof Perspex, in black or white.

entry.content:
Leica rarely uses its Hammertone finish, the 1964 Leica MD with that finish was made in a run of only ten. The M11-P Hammertone brings it back with solid brass plates, top and bottom, finished by specialists at Leica's Wetzlar workshop so that no two cameras look alike. Black leatherette with white engravings and cross-knurled controls complete the body. Technically, it matches the standard M11-P, with a full-frame sensor of up to 60 megapixels and 256 GB of built-in storage. Content Credentials attach proof of authorship to each photo. A battery in the same hammertone finish comes in the box. Leica also makes a fully mechanical M-A Hammertone for film shooters.

entry.summary: Tineco's FLOOR ONE S9 Artist combines cordless vacuuming, mopping, and high-temperature steam cleaning into a single floor-care system. Its HyperSteam technology heats steam to 320°F to tackle stubborn grease, dried spills, and embedded grime, while 22kPa suction picks up wet and
entry.content:
Tineco's FLOOR ONE S9 Artist combines cordless vacuuming, mopping, and high-temperature steam cleaning into a single floor-care system. Its HyperSteam technology heats steam to 320°F to tackle stubborn grease, dried spills, and embedded grime, while 22kPa suction picks up wet and dry messes in a single pass. An iLoop smart sensor automatically adjusts suction and water flow based on floor conditions, and the 180-degree lay-flat design reaches underneath furniture and into tight spaces. DualBlock anti-tangle technology helps manage pet hair, triple-sided edge cleaning gets closer to baseboards, and the FlashDry self-cleaning system washes the brush roller before drying it with 185°F hot air. With up to 75 minutes of runtime in Auto mode, the S9 Artist Steam makes a compelling case for retiring the traditional mop and vacuum routine.
